data.exact_reserve_text: An overall strengthening of prior year's provisions for claims during the year of approximately GBP 0.3m (2013: release of GBP 32.3m) was primarily driven by the adverse experience on the Public Liability accounts in Third party liability, strengthening of GBP 20.8m (2013: strengthening of GBP 9.2m). This is offset by the favourable experience on Marine aviation and transport GBP 14.8m (2013: release of GBP 32.6m), Fire and other damage to property GBP 3.6m (2013: release of GBP 5.6m) and Pecuniary loss GBP 2.2m (2013: release of GBP 3.3m).
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded an overall small strengthening of prior years' gross claims provisions of approximately GBP 0.3m in 2014 (a strengthening rather than a release). The deterioration was primarily driven by adverse development on Public Liability / Third party liability (strengthening ~GBP 20.8m), partially offset by favourable development in Marine aviation and transport (~GBP 14.8m), Fire and other damage to property (~GBP 3.6m) and Pecuniary loss (~GBP 2.2m). The opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 was GBP 574.782m, so the net prior year strengthening represented a very small movement relative to the opening reserves.

This is offset by the favourable experience on Marine aviation and transport GBP 14.8m (2013: release of GBP 32.6m), Fire and other damage to property GBP 3.6m (2013: release of GBP 5.6m) and Pecuniary loss GBP 2.2m (2013: release of GBP 3.3m).

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding 2013 comparative). Prior year movement taken from the note 'Movement in Prior Year's Provision for Claims' which states an approximate gross strengthening of GBP 0.3m. The note provides class-level GROSS movements for Third party liability, Marine aviation and transport, Fire and other damage to property and Pecuniary loss. 'Pecuniary loss' has been mapped to 'Professional Lines' for reporting purposes. No claims development triangle was present in the disclosed notes. Amounts are rounded to three decimal places where applicable.
